findings.detail: The custom schema validator accepts minProperties as a supported canonical keyword but never enforces it. TestExecutionResult.toolchain resolves to ToolchainIdentity, whose components object requires minProperties=1. An assurance report can therefore validate with an empty toolchain.components object, bypassing the canonical toolchain-identity requirement.
findings.requiredRepair: Implement minProperties enforcement in the deterministic schema validator and add a negative assurance-report regression proving that empty toolchain.components is rejected.
findings.title: Canonical minProperties constraints are not enforced

findings.detail: Both date-time paths call datetime.fromisoformat after replacing Z. Python accepts timezone-less values and a space separator, even though the schemas declare JSON Schema date-time. The report validator also does not require report.generatedAt to be at or after the canonical execution end time.
findings.requiredRepair: Require an RFC3339-compatible timezone-qualified timestamp, normalize comparison to aware datetimes, bind report.generatedAt to the execution interval, and add negative regressions for naive and space-separated timestamps.
findings.title: date-time validation accepts timezone-less and non-RFC3339 timestamps

findings.detail: Support promotion requires a non-empty canonical evidenceReferences array, but validation only checks immutable=true, candidate commit/tree, and a syntactically valid SHA-256. It does not resolve the evidence URI or verify the digest against durable bytes. A fabricated URI plus arbitrary lowercase digest can satisfy the support-bearing PASS gate.
findings.requiredRepair: Define a deterministic evidence-resolution boundary for repository files or workflow artifacts, verify existence and digest, and add negative regressions for missing URI targets and digest mismatch. Until then, keep requestedSupportImpact=NONE.
findings.title: Support-bearing PASS accepts unresolved evidence references

findings.detail: The exact head changes the two P8 Python files after the last manifest-controller commit without a corresponding canonical manifest update. GitHub reports no workflow runs for commit 71770c8c, and the manifest publisher creates a new commit without an explicit exact-final validation dispatch bound to that generated head.
findings.requiredRepair: Regenerate SOURCE_MANIFEST.sha256 twice through the canonical generator, publish the exact manifest commit, explicitly trigger and inspect exact final Ubuntu, Windows, macOS, product-gates, and affected integration jobs, then request a fresh review against the resulting commit/tree.
findings.title: Exact candidate manifest and CI are unsettled
